n0.text: Hail, traveller! I am Sir Strawsworth, Knight of the Corn! I have guarded these fields since... a long time ago. Birds respect me. Mostly from a distance.

n1.text: (He doesn't move. Is he... talking? Surely it's the wind.)

r0.text: I would love to chase the crows, but, you see, I am stuck on a pole. Tragic, really.
